openings.claim: Replace dependence on provisional confusion counts with a decision certificate over possible correctness contributions of unadjudicated flagged records. This may distinguish acceptance-rule uncertainty from annotation disagreement.
openings.delta: Changed dependency/carrier: the decision uses per-record candidate-minus-baseline correctness envelopes and slice envelopes. Equal predictions contribute zero regardless of label. For differing predictions, enumerate contributions from supplied label possibilities; where possibilities are unspecified, retain the conservative range [-1,1]. Select accessible flagged records whose possible revelations most affect certification, using recorded deterministic ties. Log withheld attempts and retain their uncertainty.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: adjudicate the largest provisional-annotator disagreements first, then recount. The envelope workflow could reach a supported decision with fewer revealed labels when disagreement-heavy records have little prediction influence. If both orders expose the same decisive records, no advantage is predicted. This is an unmeasured hypothesis.
openings.probe: On matched copies, run envelope-directed selection versus disagreement-first selection, each within seventy minutes and sixteen adjudications. Freeze advance/reject/unresolved reports before opening the full-label key. Record all selections, withheld attempts, reveals, time, affected slices, certificate bounds and key agreement. Advance only when every remaining feasible assignment meets total gain >=4 and each slice gain >=-2; reject only when none can meet both; otherwise unresolved. Compare correct supported decisions and adjudications consumed. A stop cap alone is not evidence of usefulness.
assumptions: The supplied records permit paired prediction contributions and slice grouping; availability must be checked without adding records.
Bounds cover every possible adjudicated label, including labels outside provisional alternatives.

Defeat conditions: withheld or excess pivotal rows leave the envelope crossing acceptance boundaries; then report unresolved. Loose bounds or computation exceeding analyst capacity can erase any benefit.
Successful certificates concern a further evaluation round only.

assessment: One live opening. Exact supplied rows are not present here, so neither influence rankings nor certificate feasibility are established. The proposed probe preserves thresholds, records every adjudication, and accommodates unavailable rows without treating their labels as known.
